question: Why did NYC yellow taxi trips drop on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 compared with the surrounding weeks?

calls.content:
{"sql":"SELECT trip_date AS target_date,
       trips AS target_trips,
       avg_total_amount AS target_avg_total_amount,
       avg_trip_distance AS target_avg_trip_distance
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28', DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21')
ORDER BY trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Aggregated output of 4 rows, one per target date. Uses DATE literal syntax per Zetaris quirks. No self-joins on the same view."}

{"sql":"SELECT holiday_date, holiday_name, is_national FROM whybot.us_holidays WHERE holiday_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28', DATE '2024-11-21', DATE '2024-12-05') ORDER BY holiday_date","tables_used":["whybot.us_holidays"],"note":"Check holiday status for 28 Nov 2024 and two surrounding Thursdays to isolate holiday effect from weekly seasonality."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT obs_date,
       prcp_mm,
       snow_mm,
       tmax_c,
       tmin_c,
       CASE WHEN dayofweek(obs_date) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' ELSE NULL END AS weekday_name
FROM whybot.nyc_weather_daily
WHERE obs_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-21' AND DATE '2024-12-05'
ORDER BY obs_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.nyc_weather_daily"],
  "note": "Selects weather metrics for 2024-11-28 and surrounding Thursdays, ordered chronologically. Uses dayofweek to identify Thursdays (dayofweek=5 per Spark convention)."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  trip_date,
  to_date(trip_date) AS trip_date_normalized,
  CASE WHEN to_date(trip_date) = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 'target' ELSE 'baseline' END AS period_type,
  avg_trip_distance AS avg_trip_distance,
  avg_total_amount AS avg_total_amount
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE to_date(trip_date) BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-21' AND DATE '2024-12-05'
ORDER BY trip_date_normalized",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Baseline vs target comparison for Thursday 28 Nov 2024. One row per date, period_type flags the target date."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  trip_date,
  trips,
  avg_total_amount,
  avg_trip_distance,
  d_day_name,
  d_holiday,
  CASE WHEN d_dow = 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN d_dow = 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim USING (d_date_id)
WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],
  "note": "One row per date in Nov-Dec 2024 showing trips, weekday type and holiday flag for comparison with us_holidays"
}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, y.avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance, d.d_day_name, d.d_holiday,
CASE WHEN d.d_dow = 5 THEN 'Friday'
     WHEN d.d_dow = 6 THEN 'Saturday'
     ELSE 'Weekday'
END AS day_type
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON y.trip_date = d.d_date
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 50","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],"note":"Join on date key columns explicitly (y.trip_date = d.d_date) not USING. d_holiday is synthetic; compare with us_holidays separately if needed."}
